quote: Customer received the notice on **August 3, 2026**. The objection deadline under §5.4 was **30 days after receipt**, i.e., **September 2, 2026**. Amendment No. 1 (dated **September 21, 2026**) states in Recital C: "No objection to the Price Adjustment Notice has been delivered by Customer..." ... The 14% increase is therefore **in effect as of October 2, 2026**.
reason: Issue 5 cites Recital C of Amendment No. 1 and the August 3, 2026 receipt date. It works out the Section 5.4 deadline as September 2, 2026 and notes this was before the September 21, 2026 amendment date. It concludes the 14% increase is deemed accepted. The memo does not expressly say the amendment contains no extension or waiver, but it says no contractual fix exists and suggests extending the period in a future amendment. That covers the same point in substance.
